title: Pip Finds Nell
checkpoint: Reception Spring 1, week 1 — Learning — Phase 3: new sounds x, y, z
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 3, 29-sound stage (x, y, z just added).

pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow standing on the edge of a wooden window box full of plants.
Pip spotting a small brown seed resting on the edge of the window box.
Pip the sparrow picking up the small brown seed in his beak.

pages.text: Pip hops on. Pip gets a bit.
pages.illustration: Pip hopping further along the window box and spotting another small brown seed.
Pip the sparrow picking up the second brown seed in his beak.

pages.text: Pip hops on. Pip gets to a pot.
pages.illustration: Pip hopping right to the end of the window box and finding a small clay plant pot.
Nell the bee sitting inside the small clay plant pot, looking up at Pip.

pages.text: Pip and Nell sit on the box.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow and Nell the bee sitting together on the edge of the window box.
